bifrost: springboard/render/src/colorspace.rs, springboard/render/src/icc.rs, springboard/render/src/rendering_intent.rs, springboard/render/src/hdr_transfer.rs, springboard/render/src/hdr_metadata.rs, springboard/sdk/src/colorsync.rs, springboard/src/shell/night_shift.rs, springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs, springboard/src/gpu/nv12.rs
summary: ColorSync is the ICC profile and colour-transform engine. BifrOSt now reads RGB matrix-shaper ICC profiles (colorants and tone curves) and converts them into the named working spaces (sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB, ROMM RGB), reads display gamma tables, models PQ and HLG transfer curves and extended-range headroom, and exposes profile conversion to apps through bifrost_app::colorsync. Lookup-table profiles, profile creation and embedding, HAGC metadata and the shell or image paths that would use these conversions are still missing; Night Shift remains a scalar tint.

features.note: Pure models with host unit tests, not yet verified on Midget. colorspace::Transform converts between named spaces; icc::MatrixShaper::convert takes an RGB matrix-shaper profile into any named space through the D50 connection space (colorspace::from_xyz_d50). No transform object for profile-to-profile pipelines and no LUT-based transforms (mft/mAB). imgdec.rs still assumes sRGB for decoded images, and nv12.rs picks Rec.601 or Rec.709 for video only.

features.apple: ColorSyncDataLayout, ColorSyncAlphaInfo, ColorSyncDataDepth (8/16/32-bit, float, premultiplied alpha)
features.note: The 8-bit premultiplied RGBA byte layout of decoded pictures is tested headless in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-07-w7.rs. Gap: no layout descriptor is exposed, and no 16-bit, float or extended-range buffers exist.

features.feature: Color profiles (ICC load, create, inspect, embed)
features.note: Headless tests in render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs cover the header and tag table checks (a_profile_header_gives..., a_tag_that_runs_past_the_profile...), the desc and mluc reads (a_version_four_description_reads_utf16...) and the matrix-shaper curves; sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs covers gamma_ramps and ProfileConverter. Gap: lookup-table profiles (A2B/B2A, mft1/mft2/mAB), profile creation, tag writing and embedding are not built; not yet verified on Midget. The PDF reader still takes ICCBased images only by component count and ignores the profile bytes.

features.feature: Standard RGB profiles (sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB, ProPhoto)
features.note: built on parity/team-j-colorsync; not yet verified on Midget. Space enumerates Srgb, DisplayP3, AdobeRgb and RommRgb with their primaries, white points and transfer curves. Apps reach them through bifrost_app::colorsync (ProfileConverter, Space). Not used by the shell, the image decoder or the PDF path, and no wide-gamut display output exists.

features.apple: ColorSyncProfileCreateWithDisplayID, display VCGT transfer tables, Night Shift via the system colour pipeline
features.note: Headless tests in tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs cover the schedule window, saved settings, the page rows, the published channel multipliers (published_settings_set_the_channel_multipliers...) and the frame tint. Night Shift tints the final presented frame with a warmth value from 0 to 1 and a daily schedule; it does not read the display profile. Profile::vcgt table and formula parsing and the 16-bit ramps are tested in render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs. Gap: kms.rs still loads no gamma ramp, so the table is not applied to the display; not yet verified on Midget.

The device registry is tested headless in render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs: registration, custom profile override and clearing (a_custom_profile_overrides...), the sRGB fallback for an unregistered display and the iteration order. Gap: kms.rs reads the CRTC gamma_size field but does not load a gamma ramp or a profile, no device registry or custom-profile setting exists in the shell, and nothing is verified on Midget.

features.feature: Rendering intents and black point compensation
features.note: Four intents (perceptual with gamut compression, relative colorimetric, saturation with clipping, absolute colorimetric without white adaptation) and affine black point compensation, on linear light. Intents from a profile's own tables are not read, and cg::color::ColorConversionInfo still treats perceptual and saturation as relative. A pure model with no caller outside its tests yet. Built on parity/team-a-09; not yet verified on Midget.

features.feature: HDR, extended range and tone mapping
features.apple: kColorSyncExtendedRange, kColorSyncPQDerivative, kColorSyncHLGDerivative, Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve (SMPTE ST 2094-50)
features.note: hdr_transfer.rs has the SMPTE ST 2084 (PQ) and ARIB STD-B67 (HLG) transfer curves and EdrHeadroom for extended-range output. hdr_metadata.rs derives per-frame peak and mean light and keeps a scene peak. Pure models with host unit tests, not wired into the shell or video output and not yet verified on Midget. No Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve (SMPTE ST 2094-50) metadata, no tone mapping into the display, and nv12.rs still selects Rec.601 or Rec.709 by frame height only.
CMM bundles are a plug-in model Apple's ColorSync loads at run time. BifrOSt has no equivalent, and no app-facing API would sit on top of one.

gaps: No lookup-table ICC transforms (A2B, B2A, mft and mAB tags) and no profile-to-profile transform pipeline; ColorSyncTransformCreate and ColorSyncTransformConvert have only the matrix path.
No profile creation, tag writing or profile embedding (ColorSyncMutableProfile, ColorSyncProfileCopyData); profiles are read only.
The working spaces are not applied to images or PDF content: decoded JPEG and PNG (imgdec.rs) stay sRGB, and PDF ICCBased colour (springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/image.rs) is drawn by component count.
No display profile path to the hardware: kms.rs reads gamma_size but loads no vcgt ramp, and Night Shift does not use the display profile.
No HAGC (SMPTE ST 2094-50) metadata and no tone mapping into a display; the HDR models are not wired into video output.
No app-facing rendering intent API; rendering_intent.rs has no caller outside its tests, and cg::color::ColorConversionInfo still treats perceptual and saturation as relative.
Colour management modules (CMM plug-ins) remain n/a.
